positive_controls.description: Both known subjects' package_digest recompute from their recorded entries; occurrence_path and package_id are the derived ones.

KS-A (6 COVERED, 0 IMPORTED, 12 GOVERNING) recomputes exactly from git at ab7fb64b, an ancestor of this lineage (tree, entries, digest, families, members with blobs); absence of the commit is a failure, not a skip.

KS-B recomputes exactly from git at 8cf94dca (39 COVERED, 7 IMPORTED including scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts, 4 GOVERNING). Runs where the candidate commit object is present (CI checks out with fetch-depth 0; 8cf94dca lives on the PR #220 branch); KS-A is an ancestor of this lineage.

KS-A and KS-B fixture occurrences validate VALID at write time and at read time; a PASS with zero nonblocking findings validates VALID; the two literals reported for KS-A and KS-B parse to PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS.
A later candidate naming the chain tip as predecessor validates and may close the predecessor's findings; occurrences of another kind do not form the chain.

Against the fixed introducing tree (be6bdf18 plus the write set): KS-A is CURRENT; KS-B is SUBJECT_NOT_PRESENT; a change outside the subject (including census execution evidence) leaves KS-A CURRENT; KS-B is CURRENT at a head that merges #220 unchanged; an earlier non-tip occurrence is valid at read time.
The real precedence allocation has no violation and every topic resolves to one domain.

EVENT_A_POLICY is PENDING with no selection; CURRENT_EVENT_A_REACHABLE = NO; the first runtime blocker is the first Event A fact of the v1.0.2 registry; the first structural blocker is G-N3 with G-N4 and DEP-C1 behind it.

Every integrated and carried historical artifact recomputes to its pinned blob; no Recovery/quiesce/census file is missing from the pinned lists; the write set is exactly three added paths; the operations delta is empty.

negative_controls.description: An IMPORTED repository module omitted from the subject STOPS (STOP_COVERED_SET_MISMATCH); an unresolvable repository import fails the derivation; a changed imported module makes the occurrence STALE_COVERED_PATH_CHANGED.
An undeclared recert scope or empty report reference STOPS (STOP_RECERT_SCOPE_UNDECLARED).

Read time: an in-place edit of the contract (STOP_OCCURRENCE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH) or of the occurrence file, compared with its FIRST add and with no deletion in history (STOP_OCCURRENCE_EDITED_AFTER_WRITE), is INVALID_AT_READ; a forked chain (two tips) is STOP_CHAIN_PREDECESSOR_MISMATCH; a declared layer edited in place or a changed non-governing family member is STALE_GOVERNING_AUTHORITY_CHANGED.

Verdict literals outside the CLOSED prefix vocabulary, or negated/qualified (CENSUS_RECERT_NOT_PASS, CENSUS_WITHDRAWN_RECERT_PASS, CENSUS_REJECTED_IC_PASS, CENSUS_DID_NOT_PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS, a bare PASS, ...) STOP (STOP_VERDICT_LITERAL_MISMATCH); a chain.predecessor with extra keys STOPS; a tree id offered as the candidate STOPS; nested extra keys and unknown entry roles STOP (STOP_OCCURRENCE_SHAPE).

Precedence: a v1.0.2 SECTION_C10 item whose text does not match its mapped prefix or whose topic is unallocated, a topic written twice in the raw artifact, the census execution gate claimed by Recovery, and a restated G-N rule under any key name are RED.
Wrong subject SHA STOPS (STOP_CANDIDATE_SHA_MISMATCH) against the known subject and against the derivation.
Same tree / wrong commit STOPS: against the known subject (STOP_CANDIDATE_SHA_MISMATCH) and, for an identical derivation, by the recert binding (STOP_RECERT_SUBJECT_MISMATCH).
Wrong tree STOPS (STOP_TREE_SHA_MISMATCH).
Wrong package digest STOPS (STOP_PACKAGE_DIGEST_MISMATCH).
Wrong authority pin STOPS even with a consistent digest (STOP_GOVERNING_PIN_MISMATCH).
blocking_findings > 0, by count or list, STOPS (STOP_BLOCKING_FINDINGS_PRESENT).

FAIL, BLOCKED and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are never promotable (STOP_VERDICT_NOT_PROMOTABLE); FAIL presented as PASS, an ambiguous literal, or a class/literal disagreement STOPS (STOP_VERDICT_LITERAL_MISMATCH).

A missing nonblocking finding, a duplicate id, PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS with none or PASS with some STOPS (STOP_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS_INCOMPLETE); a finding not OPEN STOPS (STOP_FINDING_NOT_OPEN).

materializer == author, recertifier == author, materializer == recertifier STOP, case and whitespace folded (STOP_PROVENANCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT); a reproduction claim STOPS (STOP_MATERIALIZER_REPRODUCTION_CLAIM).
An event path or package_id reused for a new candidate STOPS (STOP_OCCURRENCE_PATH_IDENTITY_MISMATCH); a second write to an existing path STOPS (STOP_OCCURRENCE_PATH_EXISTS).

Stale occurrence: covered-path change (STALE_COVERED_PATH_CHANGED), new census layer (STALE_COVERED_SET_CHANGED), governing change (STALE_GOVERNING_AUTHORITY_CHANGED), undeclared governing layer (STALE_GOVERNING_LAYER_ADDED), new recovery test after merge (STALE_COVERED_SET_CHANGED).
Unknown subject kind, including OTHER, STOPS (STOP_UNKNOWN_SUBJECT_KIND).
A census occurrence bound to the offline subject, an offline occurrence bound to the census subject, or a lane recording the other known subject STOPS (STOP_SUBJECT_KIND_MISMATCH).

Chain: ignoring an existing chain, naming a non-tip predecessor, a first occurrence naming a predecessor STOP (STOP_CHAIN_PREDECESSOR_MISMATCH); closing a foreign or predecessor-less finding STOPS (STOP_FINDING_CLOSURE_INVALID).

Shape and binding: extra or missing key (STOP_OCCURRENCE_SHAPE), wrong contract blob (STOP_OCCURRENCE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH), malformed SHA (STOP_CANDIDATE_SHA_MALFORMED), an occurrence claiming authority (STOP_OCCURRENCE_CLAIMS_AUTHORITY).
Precedence contradiction: Recovery claiming the census classification rules, superseding a CENSUS-topic locus, a shared/unknown domain, or a restated G-N condition is RED; an unallocated topic STOPS.
Historical-artifact mutation: one appended byte in any integrated or carried artifact is RED.
Event A policy silently selected (selected_option, status, decided_by, an option selected or authorized, bounded write loss authorized) is RED.
A dangling governing reference fails the derivation.

mutation_controls.description: Artifact-driven: dropping NOT from forbidden_prefix_tokens and admitting it to the vocabulary and qualifiers lets CENSUS_RECERT_NOT_PASS parse as PASS.
Live guard at every later head: every occurrence file under the occurrence root is at its derived path, valid at read time, unchanged since written, one chain tip per kind.

Live guard at every later head: a KS-B occurrence is never INVALID_AT_READ; STALE is legitimate (a shared imported module may change); CURRENT at the merged head is the #220 merge lane own check (SECTION_D12 M-3). KS-B candidate availability is required in CI.
Kill matrix: disabling any single validation check (V1..V11, R1, R2) lets at least one negative case through; zero survivors.
Self-test: a check that guards nothing is reported as a survivor, so the matrix can fail.
Artifact-driven: adding FAIL to positive_classes in the contract makes a FAIL occurrence pass V8_PROMOTABLE.
Artifact-driven: adding a kind OTHER to the enum makes an OTHER occurrence pass V1.
Artifact-driven: removing a declared non-invalidating layer turns KS-A from CURRENT to STALE_GOVERNING_LAYER_ADDED.
Artifact-driven: widening a covered prefix changes the derived identity.
